blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Text-based Person Anomaly Search (TPAS) retrieves a target pedestrian using natural-language descriptions of appearance and normal or anomalous behavior. Unlike conventional text-based person retrieval, TPAS must preserve identity cues while distinguishing fine-grained behaviors. It presents two challenges: same-identity, different-behavior hard negatives cause gradient conflict during granular alignment, while strong appearance cues can obscure weak behavioral evidence during aggregation. We propose GradCO (behavior-aware Gradient-Conflict Offloading), comprising three complementary components. Behavior-Aware Mixture-of-Experts (B-MoE) forms appearance, normal-behavior, and anomalous-behavior streams whose roles are learned from retrieval objectives without expert-specific semantic labels. Conflict Offload Learning (COL) uses pair-conditioned offload anchors in similarity computation to reduce the conflicting-gradient burden on the main text representations. Hierarchical Intent Alignment (HIA) aggregates expert similarities and features using query-conditioned weights. Experiments on five TPAS/TIPR benchmarks show GradCO significantly surpasses SOTA methods and validate our design.
blocks.zh: 基于文字的人物异常搜索(TPAS)利用自然语言的外观描述和正常或异常行为来取回目标行人. 与传统的以文字为基础的个人检索不同,TPAS必须保留身份提示,同时区分细纹行为. 它提出了两个挑战:同名同名,不同行为硬负数在颗粒对接时会引发梯度冲突,而强出相提示在聚合时会模糊弱的行为证据. 我们提议由三个互补部分组成的GradCO(行为意识分级-冲突卸载)。 Behavior-Aware Mixture-of-Experts (B-MoE) 形成外观,常态-行为和异常-行为流,其角色从检索目标中学习而无专家特有语义标签. 冲突卸载学习(COL)在类似性计算中使用配对条件卸载锚来减轻主文本表述中相冲突分级的负担. 分级意向对齐(HIA)利用有查询条件的权重来汇总专家的相似性和特征. 对五个TPAS/TIPR基准的实验显示,GradCO大大超越了SOTA方法并验证了我们的设计.

blocks.en: Text-to-Image Person Retrieval (TIPR) is a key technology in the field of multimodel learning ( Jiang et al., 2024 ; Gu et al., 2023 ; Hu et al., 2026 ; Park et al., 2024 ; Sheng et al., 2023 ; Aggarwal et al., 2020 ; Zhao et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2022 ; Jiang and Ye, 2023 ) . Recent multimodal large language models further address data selection and modality balance ( Bi et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2024 ; Bi et al., 2025b ; Aniri et al., 2026a ) . As illustrated on the left side of Figure 1 (a), this technique allows users to locate target pedestrians using natural language descriptions, offering greater flexibility and intuitiveness compared to traditional image-based ReID. However, existing person retrieval research has largely concentrated on matching the static appearance of individuals, such as “a man wearing a red T-shirt,” while often overlooking the comprehension of dynamic behaviors, particularly abnormal behaviors that are crucial in safety-critical scenarios ( Shafique et al., 2018 ; Song et al., 2025 ; Bialas, 2010 ; Theodoridis and Hu, 2012 ; Yuan et al., 2021 ; Fu et al., 2026b ; Komninos et al., 2014 )

blocks.en: To bridge the behavioral blind spot in ReID and the identity neglect in traditional visual anomaly detection ( Barbalau et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Sampieri et al., 2022 ; Hirschorn and Avidan, 2023 ; Flaborea et al., 2023 ) , Yang et al. ( Yang et al., 2025 ) introduced the Text-based Person Anomaly Search (TPAS) task ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Xie et al., 2026 ) . As shown in right side of Figure 1 (a), TPAS aims to retrieve a specific pedestrian from a large-scale image database using a natural language query describing both appearance and behavior (normal or abnormal), e.g., “the man in the blue jacket who is falling down” ( Yang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 将ReID中的行为盲点和传统视觉异常探测中的身份忽略相连接(Barbalau等人,2023年;Huang等人,2025年;Sampieri等人,2022年;Hirschorn和Avidan,2023年;Flaborea等人,2023年),杨等人. (杨等人,2025年)介绍了基于文字的人物异常搜索任务(杨等人,2025年;张等人,2026年;谢等人,2026年). 如图1(a)的右侧所示,TPAS旨在利用描述外观和行为(正常或异常)的自然语言查询,从大规模图像数据库中取回一个特定的行人,例如,“穿蓝色外套的人正在倒下”(Yang等人,2026年)。

blocks.en:
TPAS requires both fine-grained appearance discrimination from person re-identification (ReID) and subtle behavior perception from anomaly detection, posing a fundamental invariance–sensitivity conflict.
Specifically, the model must learn appearance features invariant to behavioral changes for identity recognition, while remaining sensitive to postural variations for behavior recognition. A natural solution is to disentangle the feature learning of “ invariant ” appearance and “ sensitive ” behavior, for example, by using independent identity and behavior expert streams. However, this seemingly reasonable disentanglement scheme, under the unique data distribution of the TPAS task, inevitably induces the following two deeper technical challenges.
blocks.zh:
TPAS要求从人重新身份识别(ReID)和从异常点检测到的微妙行为感都具有精细的外表歧视,这造成了根本性的不一致性-敏感性冲突。
具体地说,模型必须学习外观特征的变异性来改变行为以进行身份识别,同时对行为识别的姿势变化保持敏感. 一个自然的解决办法是将“不常态”外观和“敏感”行为的特征学习分解开来,例如通过使用独立身份和行为专家流。 然而,在TPAS任务的独特数据分配下,这种似乎合理的分散办法不可避免地引起以下两个更深层次的技术挑战。

blocks.en: C1: Gradient Conflict in Granular Alignment . We observe that hard negative samples in the TPAS task (e.g., “the same man in a blue jacket who is standing”) are designed to share identity with the positive sample (e.g., “the man in the blue jacket who is falling down”). A conventional contrastive objective therefore receives competing signals in an appearance-sensitive stream: identity similarity favors preserving the pair’s proximity, whereas behavior mismatch favors separating it. This conflict is induced by the joint retrieval objective and does not imply that the corresponding expert stream is assigned an explicit semantic label. As illustrated in Figure 1 (b), the COL-enhanced objective exhibits smaller loss fluctuations than standard InfoNCE on PAB, indicating improved optimization stability rather than directly proving semantic disentanglement.
blocks.zh: C1: Granular 对齐的渐变冲突 。 我们观察到,TPAS任务中的硬阴性样本(例如“身着蓝色外套的同一个人站立着”)旨在与正性样本(例如“身着蓝色外套的男子正在倒下”)分享身份。 因此,一个常规的对比目标在外观敏感流中接收到相互竞争的信号:身份相似性有利于保护对子的接近性,而行为不匹配则有利于分离。 这种冲突是由联合检索目标引起的,并不意味着相应的专家流被指定了明确的语义标签. 如图1(b)所示,COL增强目标显示的损失波动小于PAB上的标准InfoNCE,表明优化稳定性得到提高,而不是直接证明语义脱节。

blocks.en: C2: Aggregation Distortion of the Alignment Paradigm . Furthermore, another traditional “Aggregate-then-Align” paradigm is also incompatible with the disentanglement scheme. As illustrated in Figure 1 (c), if the identity and behavior features are forcibly aggregated (e.g., via concatenation or summation) into a single global vector, the feature strength of the appearance signal can be significantly greater than that of the behavior signal. This aggregation can cause the strong identity (appearance) signal to overwhelm the weak yet critical behavior signal. Moreover, this context-agnostic global feature cannot respond to the dynamic intent of the text (for instance, when querying “falling down,” the focus should be primarily on behavior features), leading to an “ intent mismatch .”
blocks.zh: C2:对齐范式的集合扭曲. 此外,另一个传统的“Aggregate-when-Align”范式也不符合分离计划。 如图1(c)所示,如果身份特征和行为特征被强制聚合(例如通过聚合或归纳)成单一的全球矢量,则外观信号的特征强度可以大大大于行为信号. 这种聚合可以使强烈的身份(出现)信号压倒弱而关键的行为信号. 此外,这种上下文不可知的全球特征无法响应文本的动态意图(例如,在询问“下降”时,重点应主要放在行为特征上),导致“意图不匹配”。

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we propose GradCO ( Behavior-Aware Gradient-Conflict Offloading ), a TPAS framework that combines three complementary designs. (a) Behavior-Aware Mixture-of-Experts (B-MoE) forms appearance, normal-behavior, and abnormal-behavior streams, whose relative roles emerge from retrieval training without expert-specific semantic labels. (b) Conflict Offload Learning (COL) introduces pair-conditioned offload anchors on the text side to redirect conflict-bearing gradients from hard negatives away from the main text representations. (c) Hierarchical Intent Alignment (HIA) uses text-conditioned weights to aggregate expert similarities and features, mitigating signal domination and intent mismatch.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议采用 " 行为 -- -- 警觉 -- -- 逐步 -- -- 冲突卸载 " (GradCO)这一综合三个互补设计的TPAS框架。 (a) 行为 -- -- 知识 -- -- 专家混合体(B-MoE)形成外观、正常行为和异常行为流,其相对作用来自检索培训,没有专家特有的语义标签。 (b) 冲突卸载学习(COL)在文本一侧引入附加条件的卸载锚,使带有冲突的梯度从硬负数转向主要文本表述。 (c) 等级式的意向对齐(HIA)使用文字条件加权法来汇总专家的相似性和特征,减轻信号支配和意向不匹配。

blocks.en: The main contributions are summarized as: • We identify and analyze two TPAS-specific challenges: gradient conflict from same-identity, different-behavior hard negatives and query-agnostic aggregation distortion. • We propose GradCO , which integrates B-MoE, COL, and HIA for structured expert representation, gradient offloading, and intent-aware aggregation. • Experiments on five TPAS/TIPR benchmarks demonstrate improved retrieval, corruption robustness, and out-of-distribution generalization, supported by ablation and visualization results.
blocks.zh: 主要贡献概括为:我们确定和分析两个与TPAS具体有关的挑战:同一身份的梯度冲突、不同行为的硬底片和查询-不可知的汇总扭曲。 我们提出GradCO, 将B-MOE、COL和HIA整合为结构化的专家代表、梯度卸载和意向性聚合。 · 对五个技术考绩制度/技术进度报告基准的试验显示,在减缩和可视化结果的支持下,检索、腐败程度和分配外一般化得到改进。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Text-to-Image Person Retrieval (TIPR) retrieves pedestrians from natural-language descriptions ( Chen et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2021 ; Song et al., 2022 ; Jiang et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2022 ; Song et al., 2023 ; Niu et al., 2020 ; Qian et al., 2017 ; Wang et al., 2020 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Gu et al., 2023 ; Song et al., 2026 ) . Existing work uses cross-modal attention ( Park et al., 2024 ; Shao et al., 2022 ; Shu et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2022 ; Hu et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ; Sheng et al., 2023 ) , auxiliary cues ( Jing et al., 2020 ; Aggarwal et al., 2020 ; Li et al., 2026e ) , task-specific objectives ( Sarafianos et al., 2019 ; Liu et al., 2019 ; Zheng et al., 2020 ) , and vision-language pretraining or large language models ( Bi et al., 2026b ; Bai et al., 2023 ; Song et al., 2024 ; Aniri et al., 2026b ; Han et al., 2021 ; Hu et al., 2025 ; Bi et al., 2026c ; Jiang and Ye, 2023 ; Shu et al., 2022 ; Yan et al., 2023 ; Bi et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2023a ) to align images and text ( Li et al., 2026c ; Fu et al., 2026a ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026d ) . In parallel, Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) identifies deviations from normal patterns through latent-, skeleton-, and reconstruction-based paradigms ( Sampieri et al., 2022 ; Yuan and Kitani, 2020 ; Nguyen et al., 2019 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Tang et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Gong et al., 2019 ; Barbalau et al., 2023 ; Chong and Tay, 2017 ) . TPAS unifies these settings by requiring retrieval conditioned on both pedestrian appearance and normal or anomalous behavior ( Yang et al., 2025 ) . Yet TIPR and VAD methods generally optimize identity matching and behavior recognition separately, leaving their joint alignment unresolved. GradCO addresses this gap by learning a query-responsive joint representation that preserves identity-consistent appearance cues while retaining behavior-sensitive evidence for TPAS retrieval.

TPAS通过要求以行人外观和正常或异常行为作为检索条件来统一这些设置(Yang等人,2025年)。 然而TIPR和VAD方法一般会分别优化身份匹配和行为识别,使其联合对齐未解决. 渐变 CO通过学习一个响应查询的联合代表来弥补这一差距,这种代表保留符合身份的外观提示,同时保留行为敏感的证据供TPAS检索。

blocks.en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures route inputs to multiple experts and have been applied to large-model optimization, multitask learning, transfer learning, and ReID ( Jacobs et al., 1991 ; Fedus et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2023 ; Zoph et al., 2022 ; Jaiswal et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2023b ; Li et al., 2026a ; Xu et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) . ReID MoE methods mainly model modality variation, biometric-factor fusion, or domain generalization ( Feng et al., ; Su et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) . GradCO extends MoE to this setting by redirecting conflicting optimization signals during granular alignment and making expert aggregation responsive to text intent, so identity consistency and behavior sensitivity can coexist under TPAS hard negatives.
blocks.zh: Mixture-of-Experts(MoE)架构向多位专家输入的路由,并应用于大模型优化,多任务学习,转移学习和ReID(Jacobs等人,1991年;Fedus等人,2022年;Chen等人,2023年;Zoph等人,2022年;Jaiswal等人,2025年;Li等人,2023年b;Li等人,2026a;Xu等人,2022年;Liu等人,2024年). 重新识别 MOE方法主要为模型模式变异,生物测定因子聚变,或域泛化(冯等人;苏等人,2025年;刘等人,2024年). GradCO将MOE扩展至此设置,在颗粒对齐时将相互矛盾的优化信号重定向,使专家聚合响应文本意图,因此身份一致性和行为敏感性可以在TPAS硬底片下共存.

blocks.en: GradCO organizes coupled appearance, normal-behavior, and anomal-behavior semantics into parallel expert streams, while offload anchors mitigate alignment-related gradient conflicts. As shown in Figure 2 , GradCO consists of three jointly trained components: (a) Behavior-Aware Mixture-of-Experts (B-MoE, detailed in Sec. 3.2 ) ; (b) Conflict Offload Learning (COL, detailed in Sec. 3.3 ) ; and (c) Hierarchical Intent Alignment (HIA, detailed in Sec. 3.4 ) . We first define the TPAS task and then describe each component.

blocks.en: 3.2 Behavior-Aware Mixture-of-Experts (B-MoE)

blocks.en: To model appearance and behavior cues with different invariance and sensitivity requirements, we design the Behavior-Aware Mixture-of-Experts (B-MoE) module. As shown in Figure 2 (a), B-MoE constructs three parallel streams for appearance, normal behavior, and abnormal behavior, which provide the representations for subsequent cross-modal alignment.

blocks.en: 4.1.1 Datasets.

For TPAS, we use PAB ( Yang et al., 2025 ) as the in-distribution benchmark, Multi-Weather to evaluate robustness to weather corruptions, and UCC as the out-of-distribution (OOD) test set. For TIPR, we evaluate on CUHK-PEDES ( Li et al., 2017 ) , ICFG-PEDES ( Ding et al., 2021 ) , RSTPReID ( Zhu et al., 2021 ) , and UFineBench ( Zuo et al., 2024 ) , which includes the UFine6926 and UFine3C settings.
blocks.zh: 对TPAS来说,我们使用PAB(Yang等人,2025年)作为分配基准,多织物来评价稳健性以抵御腐败,UCC作为分配外(OO)测试集. 对于TIPR,我们评价CUHK-PEDES(Li等人,2017年),ICFG-PEDES(Ding等人,2021年),RSTPReID(Zhu等人,2021年),UFine Bench(Zuo等人,2024年),包括UFine6926和UFine3C设置.

blocks.en:
PAB. Pedestrian Anomaly Behavior (PAB) Yang et al. (2025) is a benchmark for
text-based person anomaly search, which retrieves pedestrians engaged
in normal or anomalous activities using natural-language descriptions.
It contains 1,015,583 image-text pairs, including 1,013,605 synthetic
training pairs generated with diffusion models using descriptions from
OOPS! as prompts, and 1,978 real-world test pairs from OOPS!. PAB covers
1,600 anomalous action types (e.g., falling and being hit) and 1,000
normal action types (e.g., running and playing soccer). Its frame-level
descriptions cover appearance, actions, and scenes, with an average
length of 50.3 words; the training set uses an anomalous-to-normal ratio
of 3:2. To construct the test set, OpenPose and ResNet-50 are used for
filtering, followed by professional manual verification. Qwen2-VL
generates the test descriptions, which are then checked through human
quality control.

blocks.en: 4.1.2 Implementation details.
blocks.zh: 4.1.2 执行细节。

blocks.en: Following previous works ( Cao et al., 2025 ) , GradCO is initialized with the encoder weights of X2VLM ( Zeng et al., 2023 ) . We use the AdamW optimizer with a batch size of 22 22 and a weight decay of 0.01 0.01 . B-MoE contains K = 4 K=4 sub-experts, and direction-diversity regularization weight is set to γ = 0.5 \gamma=0.5 . All experiments are conducted on a NVIDIA V100 GPU with 32 32 GB memory and trained for 10 10 epochs .
blocks.zh: 继之前的作品(Cao等人,2025年)之后,GradCO以X2VLM(Zeng等人,2023年)的编码器重量初始化. 我们使用 亚当W优化器, 批量大小为22 22, 重量衰减为0.01 0.01。 B-MOE包含K=4K=4子专家,方向多样性规范化权重设定为γ=0.5\gamma=0.5. 所有实验都用一个带有3232GB内存的NVIDIA V100 GPU进行,并为10个10个纪元训练.

blocks.en: Evaluation. For TPAS, we report Recall@K (R@K, K ∈ { 1 , 5 , 10 } K\in\{1,5,10\} ) and mean Average Precision (mAP). For TIPR, R-Avg is the arithmetic mean of R@1, R@5, and R@10. On Multi-Weather, we report R@1 and mAP for each of the ten weather conditions and their arithmetic means. PAB-Avg and UCC(OOD)-Avg follow the corresponding protocols. Higher scores indicate better retrieval performance.

blocks.en: We compare GradCO with existing methods on the TPAS and TIPR tasks. For TPAS, we evaluate in-distribution retrieval on PAB, robustness under the Multi-Weather protocol, and transfer to the UCC out-of-distribution (OOD) test set. We then evaluate whether the same model remains effective on conventional TIPR benchmarks.

blocks.en: PAB evaluation. Table 1 reports the results on PAB under the 0.1 0.1 M and 1 1 M gallery settings. GradCO achieves the highest R@1, R@5, and mAP in both settings, and ties CMP at 1 1 M R@10. Under the 0.1 0.1 M setting, GradCO improves R@1 from 83.06 83.06 to 85.39 85.39 and mAP from 90.41 90.41 to 92.13 92.13 over CMP. Under the 1 1 M setting, the corresponding gains are 1.67 1.67 and 1.22 1.22 percentage points. These results show that GradCO improves text-to-image retrieval when the query combines identity-related appearance with normal or anomalous behavior.
blocks.zh: 人事委员会评价。 表1在0.1 M和1 M画廊设置下报告了有关个人资料包的结果。 GradCO在两种情况下都实现了最高的R@1,R@5和mAP,并将CMP连为1,1M R@10. 在0.1M设定下,GradCO将R@1从83.06 83.06改进为85.39 85.39,mAP从90.41 90.41改进为92.13 92.13,高于CMP. 在1M设定下,相应的收益为1.671.67和1.221.22个百分点. 这些结果显示,当查询将身份相关外观与正常或异常行为相结合时,GradCO会改进文本到图像的检索.

blocks.en: Multi-Weather evaluation. Table 2 reports R@1 and mAP under ten weather conditions. GradCO achieves the highest value for both metrics in every condition, including the challenging “Dark+Rain” setting. Its mean R@1 and mAP are 72.2 72.2 and 80.67 80.67 , compared with 67.12 67.12 and 77.44 77.44 for CMP. The consistent gains across conditions indicate that the multistream representation and query-conditioned aggregation remain effective when the visual evidence is degraded by weather changes.
blocks.zh: 多织评价. 表2报告了R@1和mAP在10个天气条件下的情况。 GradCO在每个条件中,包括具有挑战性的“Dark+Rain”设定中,对两个度量衡都达到最高值。 其平均值R@1和mAP为72.2 72.2和80.67 80.67,而CMP为67.12 67.12和77.44 77.44。 不同条件的一致收益表明,当视证因天气变化而退化时,多流表示和有查询条件的汇总依然有效。

blocks.en: OOD evaluation. Table 3 evaluates transfer to UCC. With the 1 1 M gallery, GradCO improves over CMP from 55.23 55.23 to 62.53 62.53 in R@1 and from 44.35 44.35 to 52.01 52.01 in mAP, corresponding to gains of 7.30 7.30 and 7.66 7.66 percentage points. The improvement is also observed in the 1 1 M gallery setting, showing that GradCO transfers more effectively to the tested OOD domain.
blocks.zh: OD评价. 表3评估向UCC的转移情况。 随着1个M画廊的建设,GradCO比CMP从55.23 55.23升至62.53 62.53 R@1,从44.35 44.35升至52.01 52.01 mAP,同比增长7.30 7.30和7.66 7.66个百分点. 在11M画廊设置中也观察到了这一改进,表明GradCO更有效地向测试过的OOD域转移.

blocks.en: TIPR evaluation. Table 4 summarizes the average R@K on five TIPR evaluation sets. GradCO obtains the highest score on CUHK-PEDES, ICFG-PEDES, RSTPReID, and UFine3C. On UFine6926, Bi-IRRA reaches 95.18 95.18 , while GradCO obtains 95.13 95.13 . The largest improvement appears on UFine3C, where GradCO reaches 82.01 82.01 compared with 74.63 74.63 for CFAM. These results show that the appearance–behavior modeling and intent-conditioned matching developed for TPAS also improve retrieval under conventional and cross-domain TIPR settings.

blocks.en: To analyze the sensitivity of GradCO to the number of B-MoE sub-experts and the direction-diversity weight γ \gamma , we vary both hyperparameters and report the results in Figure 5 . For both parameters, the performance first increases and then decreases. Setting K = 4 K=4 provides sufficient perspectives for separating appearance and behavior cues, whereas a larger value (e.g., K ≥ 5 K\geq 5 ) may over-partition features and make experts focus on local details. The best performance is obtained at γ = 0.5 \gamma=0.5 , which helps prevent anchor collapse. A larger γ \gamma over-constrains anchor directions, while a smaller value provides insufficient regularization, leading to less reliable offloading and stronger residual conflicts. We use K = 4 K=4 and γ = 0.5 \gamma=0.5 in all experiments.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we investigate the TPAS task and reveal two key challenges of existing decoupling paradigms: gradient conflict and aggregation distortion. To address these challenges, we propose GradCO, a hierarchical Mixture-of-Experts framework that decouples appearance and behavior, alleviates hard-negative-induced optimization conflicts through Conflict Offload Learning, and enables intent-aware feature aggregation with Hierarchical Intent Alignment. Extensive experiments on five TPAS/TIPR benchmark datasets validate the effectiveness and robustness of our approach.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们调查了TPAS的任务,并揭示了现有脱钩模式的两个关键挑战:梯度冲突和汇总扭曲。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议格拉德科(GradCO),这是一个分级的专家混合框架,可以解开外表和行为,通过冲突脱载学习来缓解硬负引起的优化冲突,并使得意向意识特征与分级内向对齐。 对五个TPAS/TIPR基准数据集的广泛试验验证了我们方法的有效性和稳健性。
